payload.body: You tend to anticipate what everyone else needs and then resent being asked for one more thing. At other times, you refuse care or closeness before anyone has actually demanded too much. Underneath is often a history in which being needed brought connection but left little room for your own feelings. Ask what is actually expected before choosing between overgiving and withdrawing.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite the Moon can pull you between caring for other people and refusing any expectation that you will keep doing it.
